title: The Rock vs. John Cena: challenge and redemption
summary: Cena’s rivalry with the returning Rock becomes a WrestleMania attraction. After losing their first singles meeting, Cena gets a championship rematch.

chapters.title: A match is set one year ahead
chapters.result: The Rock and Cena agree to meet at WrestleMania XXVIII.
chapters.context: The challenge follows Rock’s involvement in Cena’s WrestleMania XXVII defeat.

chapters.title: Rock wins in Miami
chapters.context: Cena’s loss becomes the basis for his redemption pursuit.

chapters.title: Cena wins the title rematch
chapters.result: Cena defeats The Rock for the WWE Championship.
chapters.context: The second meeting reverses the first result.
